proposals.evidence: DEDR 215 compares Tamil arici husked rice, Malayalam ari, Kannada/Kodagu akki and Kota aky husked grain. The selected simple survey rice nouns fit these branches; ari-maṇi and other combined responses require separate components. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
